profiles.title: Eunomia: unresolved source alternatives
profiles.source_meaning: The source gives incompatible Refined Resilience and Functional Order definitions; both must be shown without silently selecting or merging them.

alternatives.label: Dedicated chapter: Refined Resilience
alternatives.source_meaning: An exposed resilient core surviving loss; rebuilding from what remains strongest. The chapter explicitly rejects law, fairness, justice and order as its definition.

alternatives.label: Comparative table: Functional Order
alternatives.source_meaning: Systems that align and work by design; the table describes this as mechanical rather than social order.

exceptions: Neither precedence nor an author erratum has been established.
Do not substitute the generic mythological law/good-governance definition or merge both creator-authored alternatives.
